title: Audit the correction before releasing the design
lead: The final lesson asks for a justified release decision, not the largest possible green score. Bring capacity, connectivity, protection, thermal behaviour, controls and evidence together. Then audit a proposed correction from the manuscript’s separate campus example: a remedy is another engineering assertion and must be recalculated.
objectives: Reject a proposed remedy that still fails its capacity or current screen.
Preserve source namespaces and unresolved evidence in the final decision.

sections.title: A release condition is an intersection
sections.body: The twenty-megawatt case uses one consistent load ledger across utility, transformers, generator banks, UPS, batteries, distribution, cooling and station DC. A failed necessary condition is sufficient to reject the corresponding design claim. Passing every simplified screen still does not replace the full project studies. The source generator-bank claim fails, while battery sizing, distribution studies and cooling demonstration remain open. Proposed PV has no established firm contingency credit.

sections.title: Recalculate a proposed campus remedy
sections.body: The separate campus review assumes 560 MVA demand per independently full-capacity side. Three 250 MVA transformers leave only 500 MVA after one loss, so the suggested N+1 remedy fails. Four units are required by the elementary count. The same 250 MVA transformer at 22 kV has approximately 6,560.80 A full-load current; a 6,300 A incomer, or two nominal 3,150 A incomers, does not reach that total. A larger replacement number is not enough unless it meets the declared duty.

sections.title: Close only what the evidence closes
sections.body: A high current can expose unsupported equipment feasibility without proving universal physical impossibility. Preserve source-qualified identities: S01:SLD-002 is not interchangeable with the design-series DCD-002. The manuscript describes twelve reference families, but its accompanying 525-entry atlas and original corpus were not supplied with this task. The capstone can teach selection criteria and namespace discipline; it cannot claim to expose that missing archive.

challenge.question: Does correcting the transformer count close the whole design?
challenge.answer: Surviving capacity becomes 750 MVA, but the 6,300 A incomer still falls below approximately 6,560.80 A. Other required studies remain unresolved, so the design-release outcome remains HOLD.

instructions: Read the declared boundary and units. Predict the selected result before calculating.
Run the starting case and inspect the ledger, assumptions and model limits.
Apply the challenge, run again, and explain the difference. Export only the last completed inputs and results.

scene.title: The evidence-controlled release gate
storyboard: Open the twenty-megawatt review matrix without mixing it with the separate campus case.
Switch to the campus remedy, remove one transformer and expose the remaining shortfall.
Recalculate a changed unit count while keeping the independent current issue visible.
Assemble six explicit gate states; unresolved or failed evidence leads to HOLD.
scene.interaction: Choose pass/fail/unresolved for six justified criteria; require a reason and source locator before exporting the review.
scene.staticAlternative: Six-condition acceptance matrix with blocking reasons and a source-qualified case register.
scene.projection: orthographic axonometric SVG with upright HTML labels
scene.timelineSemantics: Narrative steps unless an explicitly labelled physical-time model is active.
scene.reducedMotion: Same states and values; no particles, parallax, camera travel or tweening.

assessments.question: Find the elementary N+1 count per side for 560 MVA using 200 MVA units.
assessments.answer: Four installed per side; three remain with 600 MVA.
assessments.rubric: Do not combine independent sides to satisfy one side’s duty.

assessments.question: Find the nominal full-load current screen for 100 MVA at 33 kV.
assessments.answer: Approximately 1,749.55 A before site and operating allowances.
assessments.rubric: Use total three-phase apparent power and line-to-line voltage.

assessments.question: Why does a corrected equipment count not close a Tier or fault-tolerance claim?
assessments.answer: Connectivity, protection, dynamics, cooling, controls, maintenance and the applicable assessment criteria still need evidence.
assessments.rubric: Acknowledge all relevant boundaries; do not award certification.

limits: The design-review HOLD is separate from the software release status.
No missing atlas, normative standard text, manufacturer capability or professional approval is invented.
